impact.text: balanceOf(vault) is now > 0  unregisterVaultpermanently reverts with CannotUnregisterVaultAssetBalance

precondition_sources.text: The vault is empty and deactivated, so totalAssets() returns 0.

intent_sources.text: unregisterVault must succeed in removing a vault from the registry once the vault is empty and deactivated, i.e. when totalAssets() returns 0.
Tokens sent directly to the vault (donations, dust, airdrops) must not prevent unregisterVault from succeeding.
